objective: Reduce the owned non-interlaced RGBA8 APNG path without changing pixels, replay policy, retained-state budget, checkpoint policy, cancellation semantics, or the admitted format envelope, then determine whether the historical PIA-6 latency deficit remains true for the current source tree.
mechanisms: RFC1950 inflate reads the raw-deflate payload directly from the encoded buffer instead of materializing a second Data slice.
Adler-32 keeps wide accumulators and reduces modulo 65521 once per 5552-byte block instead of performing two integer modulo operations for every decoded byte.
PNG unfilter writes directly into the final Data allocation, dispatches the filter once per row, and specializes the RGBA8 four-byte filter distance; filter-0 rows use memcpy.
Full-canvas straight-alpha to premultiplied-RGBA conversion uses Accelerate vImagePremultiplyData_RGBA8888 with exact-byte regression coverage instead of the scalar per-pixel loop.

PNG CRC is computed directly over the original encoded type-plus-payload byte range; parser fields read from the encoded buffer and compressed payloads append slices without constructing per-chunk payload and CRC-input copies.
nonChanges: modeled peak upper bound remains 981940 bytes
canvas and materialized-output accounting remain separate full RGBA surfaces
no public API or format-admission expansion is introduced

historicalSupersession.interpretation: The historical slow-path result remains valid for its bound earlier working tree but is no longer a current-tree performance fact. The current source-bound directional capture reverses both median comparisons on the same retained PIA-6 workload without changing replay or retained-state policy.

claimBoundary: The final capture is a physical-Mac directional mechanism endpoint and is explicitly not formal-claim eligible.
No online physical iOS device was available; physicalIOSDeviceOnlineCount was zero.
The study covers one owned APNG scenario and does not establish all-content, all-format, third-party-library, product, energy, thermal, allocator, or reclamation superiority.
Direct ImageIO prepare is a lower bound and its unbounded cached-all-frames mode is not a bounded comparator.
Host-load variation remains visible in repeated short A/B blocks; medians and direct controls are used only directionally.
